block.appliedcraftedenergistics.me_gas_i: Bridges an ME network and an adjacent gas tank or gas pipe network, with a real buffer tank in between.
item.appliedcraftedenergistics.gas_p2p_t: Moves gas between linked faces through the ME network. Right-click with a gas canister to attune.
item.appliedcraftedenergistics.pressure_: Raises a gas cell's rated pressure from 16 atm to CCB's hard limit of 24 atm (x1.5 capacity).
item.appliedcraftedenergistics.volume_ca: Adds 50% virtual vessel volume to a gas cell. Up to 4 per cell.
item.appliedcraftedenergistics.type_expa: Lets a gas cell hold 4 more gas types. Up to 2 per cell.
item.appliedcraftedenergistics.relief_va: Vents the excess when upgrading shrinks a gas cell below its contents.
gui.appliedcraftedenergistics.title: Applied Crafted Energistics
tooltip.appliedcraftedenergistics.cell.p: Gas is stored at the cell's rated pressure; the cell is a virtual vessel and never takes part in CCB overpressure.
tooltip.appliedcraftedenergistics.cell.c: Upgrade cards boost capacity, rated pressure and gas types; a carded cell therefore reports more AE bytes.
tooltip.appliedcraftedenergistics.cell.o: Over-filled: remove gas or install a Relief Valve Card.
item.appliedcraftedenergistics.slot_cont: Unlocks independent Input / Output / Both / Off control for each of the gas ME Interface's nine slots.
item.appliedcraftedenergistics.safety_va: Vents dangerous overpressure from the gas ME Interface through Create: Crafted Beginning's real gas release.
item.appliedcraftedenergistics.gas_sampl: Mark a gas config slot of the ME Gas Interface by right-clicking the slot with this sample. Obtain samples from JEI or the creative tab.
item.appliedcraftedenergistics.gas_press: Install in an AE2 import/export bus to set its gas target pressure. Export stops at the target; import only drains above it.
Right-click to cycle; sneak-right-click to go back
